name: The Wish
designNote: Aha: everything at once. Shove the crates to free the balance stones, line up to flip the Tarnish, take the mirror shrine, rock the stones back and forth, and lure Lune's Tarnish into her pit before both step onto the wish altars together, still holding their coins.
hints: This one asks for everything you've learned, and a lot of moves.
After the mirror shrine, rock the balance stones and lure Lune's Tarnish into her pit before heading for the altars.
